cards.mood: The piece opens with a gritty, narrative-driven tension that feels arid and weary, reflecting a struggle against adversity.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
The dust hangs heavy in the hollow air
My shadow stretches long across the clay
The well is sinking deep into the ground
I’m walking miles just to find my way
[Pre-Chorus]
Clouds are heavy with a secret weight
Waiting for the sky to break and pour
[Chorus]
Let the rain wash the spirit clean
Break the silence of the thirsty land
Hold my heart in the palm of grace
Rise like a river from the sand

Every seed is praying for a drink
Every stone is burning in the heat
I’ve been trading sweat for a little hope
With a heavy rhythm in my steady beat
